title: Home rain gauge written guide
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y7 lesson 14 (Home rain gauge written guide (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 14: Meet the River Thames: the water cycle at work. Read it all first; an adult knows what you are doing.

safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Tidy up and wash your hands
method: An adult cuts the top off the bottle
Put stones in the bottom and turn the top upside down into it as a funnel
Tape a ruler to the side, with 0 at the water level after you add a little water
Put it in an open place away from trees and roofs
Read the level at the same time every day and empty it

questions.q: Big question: where does the Thames' water come from?
questions.a: Rain falling on its drainage basin, reaching it by run-off, through soil and as groundwater
